reviews.title: Good MB, plenty of storage options
reviews.comment: So far it's a good board, my only real issue is with expansion - particularly that of SSD drives.  While it's a simple matter to plug in the cables for a new HDD, the many covers and architecture of the board makes adding an SSD rather troublesome.  IF I want to max SSD's, I'll have to remove the Video Card and the "cover plate" for M2_2, and there is also the trade off of SATA_1 if M2_3 is mounted.  These are minor issues, unless you are trying to build the "ultimate" computer system - with 7 SATA's and 4 M.2 slots (minus one of either due to overlapping use) you have 10, total, storage devices - with HDDs currently at about 20TB (ea.) you can build a system with over 140TB HDD + 12TB M.2 totaling OVER 150TB of INTERNAL storage, plus nearly unlimited externally (on HDDs or USB (Thumb Drives)).  While I tend to run my systems without sidewalls, I don't "care" about the lights and hard plastic "covers" that are prevalent on modern MBs, It does look good, if you care - although I've seen units with more "bells and whistles" (including "back connectors" - for power and wires to make for a "cleaner" install), I don't mind a few wires across the front.  I WANT a unit that LOOKS like it is electronics, and I'd actually prefer it was a bit larger - with my older, "big", "clumsy", arthritic hands it was kinda tight getting the MB installed in my new case - which seems to have been designed more for looks than function (the cable routing actually complicated matters).
reviews.author: David R Elliott

reviews.title: Muy buen producto, pésimo embalaje
reviews.comment:
Buen producto, tal como su descripción.
Algo importante es que es un producto de segunda mano, este dato no esta lo suficientemente destacado en la publicación.
Lo único malo, y que realmente pudo ser un problema grave, es que fue empaquetada en una bolsa antiestática dentro de una caja genérica. Sin ningún recubrimiento que amortizara los golpes, pudo haberse roto en los movimientos del viaje.
reviews.author: Jose L.
